name: Facilities and maintenance coordinator
summary: Keeps equipment, vehicles and buildings working: asset registers, preventive maintenance schedules, check sheets and work orders.

changelog.note: First release: 30 sources (HSE legionella, L8 and HSG274, GOV.UK fire safety, PUWER, PAT, contractors, CDM, asbestos, gas, OSHA, CDC, EU water and work equipment rules, DVSA and US driver reports, MaintainX, UpKeep and Fleetio help pages), four skills, five prompts, three workflows, training interview and test briefs, access levels per tool.
